Lemma
[Locality along a curve]

Source: petersen:page-0074 ↗ def:pet-ch2-affine-connection

1. ch2:2.2.4Let $ abla $ be an affine connection, $X$ a vector field, and $c:I o M$ smooth with $c(0)=p$ and $\dot c(0)=v\in T_pM$. If $X\circ c=Y\circ c$ for another vector field $Y$, then $ abla _vX= abla _vY$.
Proof

↗ def:pet-ch2-affine-connection \sketch In a local frame $E_i$, write $X=X^iE_i$ and $Y=Y^iE_i$. Equality along $c$ gives $X^i(p)=Y^i(p)$ and $dX^i(v)= rac d{dt}(X^i\circ c)|_0 = rac d{dt}(Y^i\circ c)|_0=dY^i(v)$. The connection’s Leibniz rule applied to the two frame expansions then gives $ abla _vX= abla _vY$.

□
